title: Webhound
claim: Product Hunt: Webhound — A research engine for your agent
why_good: Webhound addresses the growing need for specialized research tools tailored for AI agents, filling a niche that general search engines overlook.
value: Businesses developing AI agents could pay for premium features or subscriptions to enhance their agents' research capabilities, creating a steady revenue stream.
risk: The project may struggle to gain traction if larger tech companies decide to integrate similar functionalities into their existing platforms.
